independence.source_limit: OSHB and UXLC are correlated WLC-family witnesses; their agreement is not independent textual convergence and section markers are evidence, not boundary authority.

verdict_semantics: For split proposals, support endorses the listed children; for retain proposals, support endorses the retained span. Challenge gives the preferred alternative. Insufficient preserves the larger unit pending the exact question.

dockets.evidence: The watchman charge closes its four-case warning logic at 3:21; 3:22 opens a new plain scene with Yahweh's hand, a movement command, renewed glory encounter, confinement, muteness, and later speech release. Both children are complete six-verse movements.
dockets.counterevidence: There is no MT section marker after 3:21, and both movements complete the same call-and-commission sequence.

dockets.evidence: 11:14 begins a fresh word-event and 11:14-21 is a direct remnant/restoration oracle; 11:22 switches to narrated cherubim movement, glory departure, visionary transport, and the prophet's report to the exiles.
dockets.counterevidence: No MT section marker stands after 11:21, and 11:22-25 is not independent of the vision begun in chapter 8.

preferred_children_or_retained_parent.hydration: The second child must retrieve with the complete temple-vision parent.

dockets.evidence: A pe closes 13:16; 13:17 directly readdresses the prophet to the daughters of his people. The first indictment uses fox/wall/whitewash imagery, while the second uses bands, veils, hunting, and deliverance imagery.
dockets.counterevidence: Both are indictments of self-originating prophecy and together form a paired false-prophecy collection.

dockets.evidence: A samekh follows 16:58, and 16:59 begins a new Lord-Yahweh formula and remembered-covenant coda.
dockets.counterevidence: The five-verse coda resolves the same allegory and can become a decontextualized forgiveness proof text if detached from accusation, shame, and covenant breach.
dockets.exact_human_question_if_unresolved: Can the system guarantee that Ezek.16.59-Ezek.16.63 is never surfaced without Ezek.16.1-Ezek.16.63 and an explicit sexualized-violence/covenant-context warning; if not, should Ezek.16.44-Ezek.16.63 remain indivisible?

dockets.evidence: 21:28 explicitly begins a new command and redirects the oracle to Ammon after a pe in the MT sequence. By contrast, 21:24 begins 'Therefore' and applies the road/divination scene of 21:18-23 to Jerusalem's remembered guilt and ruler.
dockets.counterevidence: 21:24 has a new Lord-Yahweh formula and 21:24-27 has its own royal-address movement.

preferred_children_or_retained_parent.rejected: The three-way split severs the divination outcome from its direct therefore-application.

dockets.evidence: A samekh closes 23:35; 23:36 begins a renewed divine address and judicial commission, shifting from the two-sisters allegorical narration to accusation, sentence, and exemplum.
dockets.counterevidence: The judicial movement interprets and completes the same two-sisters allegory and must not be detached from it.

preferred_children_or_retained_parent.hydration: Both children require the shared allegory parent and sexualized-violence/divine-agency warning.

dockets.evidence: The Sidon oracle begun at 28:20 closes with its recognition formula at 28:24 and a samekh; 28:25 begins a new Lord-Yahweh formula, changes addressee to the house of Israel, and functions as a gathering/security coda for the surrounding-nations sequence.
dockets.counterevidence: The proposed second child is only two verses and its collection-closing function is clearer with the nation-oracle parent than alone.

preferred_children_or_retained_parent.hydration: Ezek.28.25-Ezek.28.26 must remain a contextual coda, not an unhydrated standalone unit.

dockets.evidence: 34:17-22 completes the flock-against-flock judgment. 34:23 turns to one shepherd, but the two-verse shepherd promise flows directly into the covenant-of-peace and secure-land promises at 34:25-31; no section marker supports isolating 34:23-24.
dockets.counterevidence: The shepherd appointment and covenant-of-peace material are distinguishable motifs.

preferred_children_or_retained_parent.rejected: The three-way split creates an under-contextualized two-verse child.

dockets.evidence: 44:1-3 is a complete return-to-east-gate/prince-access scene. At 44:4 the guide relocates northward, the glory fills the house, and a new attention command introduces sanctuary-access rules; 44:10 then narrows from foreigners generally to the Levites' penalty and service.
dockets.counterevidence: No section marker follows 44:3, and the closed east gate motivates the ensuing access regulation; all three belong to the uninterrupted vision tour.

preferred_children_or_retained_parent.hydration: The three-verse gate scene and access rules must retain the guided-vision and cultic-law parent.

dockets.evidence: The sequence has four real prescriptive frames: sanctuary cleansing by first/seventh-month days; Passover and seventh-month festivals; a fresh Lord-Yahweh gate/prince/Sabbath-new-moon/freewill register at 46:1 after a samekh; and the daily morning offering at 46:13. Each closes its own schedule.
dockets.counterevidence: The children are short, 46:13 lacks an immediately preceding section marker, and all four form one cultic calendar/gate register with qere/ketiv pressure at 46:9 and 46:15.

preferred_children_or_retained_parent.hydration: Every child requires the final-vision parent and a non-authorizing temple/legal/ritual warning.

dockets.evidence: 48:23-29 completes the remaining tribal allotments and closes with an explicit land-allotment summary; 48:30 resets to city exits, named gates, circumference, and the climactic city name.
dockets.counterevidence: No MT section marker follows 48:29, and both movements close the same land/city vision.

dockets.evidence: Standing, hearing, non-rebellion, scroll presentation, eating command, and performed ingestion are one commission chain; chapter 3 begins by repeating and completing the command rather than resetting the scene.
dockets.counterevidence: The scroll appears at 2:8 and the eating performance at 3:1-3 could be tagged as subordinate phases.

dockets.evidence: Tablet, posture, ration, fuel negotiation, and scarcity interpretation cumulatively enact one siege-sign complex; the duration in 4:9 explicitly refers back to lying on the side.
dockets.counterevidence: Fresh imperatives at 4:4 and 4:9 and a samekh before 4:4 expose three subordinate sign phases.

dockets.evidence: The hair command and thirds performance in 5:1-4 are decoded by the Jerusalem formula at 5:5 and the matching thirds judgment at 5:12; separation would orphan sign from interpretation.
dockets.counterevidence: 5:5 begins a formal application oracle that could be indexed as a subordinate movement.

dockets.evidence: Baggage/wall commands, performance, morning audience question, prince application, scattering, and remnant purpose form a complete command-performance-question-interpretation sign act.
dockets.counterevidence: 12:8 begins a fresh morning word-event, marking the interpretation phase.

dockets.evidence: A fresh word-event commands fearful eating and drinking, immediately followed by its inhabitants/land interpretation and recognition close.
dockets.counterevidence: Command and interpretation could be separately described, but neither is independently complete.

dockets.evidence: The sustained vine-wood questions and fire analogy reach their explicit Jerusalem application only at 15:6-8.
dockets.counterevidence: 15:6 has a Lord-Yahweh application formula, but it answers the preceding analogy rather than opening an independent oracle.

dockets.evidence: The eagle/vine riddle, its royal explanation beginning with a renewed word-event at 17:11, oath judgment, and tender-cedar conclusion share one image system and interpretive arc.
dockets.counterevidence: 17:11 and 17:22 are formal internal resets and can be indexed as interpretation and concluding promise phases.

dockets.evidence: The south/forest/fire oracle elicits the prophet's 'speaker of parables' complaint at 20:49; 21:1-7 answers by replacing the vegetation directions with Jerusalem/sanctuary/land and by adding the sigh sign and audience answer. The MT-aligned OSHB/UXLC span is Ezek.21.1-Ezek.21.12, so the English chapter seam is not a literary seam.
dockets.counterevidence: WEB 21:1 begins a fresh word-event and a more explicit sword oracle, so it remains a visible internal interpretation phase.

preferred_children_or_retained_parent.hydration: Retain violence/divine-agency warning and the WEB-to-MT crosswalk.

dockets.evidence: The exact siege date, pot command, contents, blood/rust accusation, intensified fire, and final judgment formula form one dated parable with interpretation.
dockets.counterevidence: The repeated woe formulas at 24:6 and 24:9 expose rhetorical phases, not independent units.

dockets.evidence: The wife-sign command, narrated death/performance, audience question, explanation identifying Ezekiel as sign, fugitive forecast, and mouth-opening close are mutually dependent.
dockets.counterevidence: 24:25-27 projects a later event and also functions as a hinge into the post-fall watchman material.

dockets.evidence: Vision transport, inspection, two prophesy commands and performances, body/breath stages, and the explicit whole-house interpretation at 37:11-14 form one vision-answer chain; ruach polysemy is evidence and a translation guard, not a seam.
dockets.counterevidence: 37:11 introduces an explicit interpretive speech that can be indexed as a subordinate phase.

dockets.evidence: Inscribed-stick commands, joining performance, audience question, unity explanation, shepherd/covenant/sanctuary development, and recognition close form one sign-act interpretation.
dockets.counterevidence: The explanation expands well beyond the object lesson and contains several promise motifs, but none resets the word-event.

dockets.evidence: The same guide brings the prophet from porch to nave to inner room while repeating measurement verbs; 41:4 supplies the destination label, 'the most holy place.' Neither speaker, tour, action, nor object complex resets at the chapter seam.
dockets.counterevidence: Porch, nave, and inner room are distinguishable spatial stations and could be indexed below chunk level.

dockets.evidence: The guide follows one watercourse from temple source through four depth measurements, asks the interpretive question, then describes sea healing, salt exception, fish, and trees as effects of that same water.
dockets.counterevidence: The direct explanation beginning at 47:8 can be indexed as a subordinate interpretive phase.

dockets.evidence: The inheritance frame introduces equal shares, then traverses four borders, and returns at 47:21-23 to distribution and resident-alien allotment; border details and allocation rule perform one register function.
dockets.counterevidence: The border itinerary and resident-alien coda are distinguishable internal subsections.

summary.note: Counts are recomputed by validation; the hand-authored summary support count intentionally excludes no docket.
